lots.key_photo_findings: Four photos. Carved scroll arm with roundel, bolster with rosette ends, carved serpentine back with scroll terminal, square blocks carved with a pyramid-star over faceted turned legs, brass castors. Red-brown timber with good colour. No marks or labels visible. Upholstery is a later burgundy fabric, a little worn and puckered.
lots.condition: Frame looks sound in photos, colour good. Upholstery later and worn; springing and underside not shown.
lots.question_for_armitage: Is the timber confirmed as Australian cedar (secondary timbers too)? Length? Are the springs and webbing sound, and are there frame repairs, replaced legs or replaced castors? Any photo of the underside?

Dealer asking prices are not used for either figure. Only one sold comp, from NZ, so treat both maxima as conservative.

lots.key_photo_findings: Six photos. Strongly figured flame mahogany top, fold-over with brass hinges, carved rosettes on frieze ends, faceted column with beaded collar and lotus-leaf base, concave four-point platform on carved bun feet. Enlarged photo 3: small split or lifted chip at the right front edge of the top and a short dark scratch or burn mark near it. Inner surface shown as polished timber (no baize visible). No marks.
lots.condition: Good overall. Small split/chip at one top edge and a short scratch; age wear. Swivel action and interior well not shown.
lots.question_for_armitage: How long is the split at the top edge and has it lifted? Does the top swivel and fold smoothly, is the hinge sound, and is there a storage well under the top? Any underside photo to check for repairs to the column and base?

lots.question_for_armitage: Can you confirm size and show the certificate (#370) and who issued it? Any moth, stains, repairs or odour, and are the fringes and selvedges intact?
